items.a: On Thursday 19 November 2026, at midnight local time in most countries, starting with New Zealand. The US and Canada unlocked together at midnight Eastern, which was 9 PM Pacific on the 18th. Where you are, it unlocked {unlock}.

Yes. GTA 6 scored 99 on Metacritic, tying The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest score on the site. Critics praised the world and the story; the 30 fps target, some clunky combat and a crowded Vice City were the most common complaints.

items.q: How many copies has GTA 6 sold?
items.a: Take-Two says it sold 32.5 million units before release and made about $3.79 billion in retail sales worldwide by the end of launch day, 19 November. Those are the company's own estimates, and it called it the biggest launch of any entertainment product.
The Standard Edition is $79.99 in the US, £69.99 in the UK and €79.99 in the eurozone. Ultimate is $99.99, £89.99 or €99.99. Prices for {country}: {std} Standard, {ult} Ultimate.

Not at launch. Rockstar hasn't announced a PC version. GamesBeat reported in October 2026, citing four sources, that a PC release is planned for January to March 2027. Rockstar didn't comment, so treat that as unconfirmed.
Not at launch. Rockstar calls GTA 6 a single-player experience and hasn't announced an online mode. Any dates you see are rumours.
PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Xbox One owners can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming. There's no PS4 or Switch version.

items.q: What frame rate does it run at?
items.a: 30 frames per second on every console, PS5 Pro included, and there's no performance or 60 fps mode. Digital Foundry found the PS5 Pro holds 30 most steadily, with sharper upscaling and ray-traced shadows. Base PS5 and Series X mostly hold 30 but dip into the 20s in heavy action, and Series S renders at 720p, upscaled to about 1080p, and often runs in the mid-20s.

No. GTA 6 is played in third person, and the camera settings have no first-person option. Players have found a glitch that switches the view, but it isn't an official mode and Rockstar hasn't said whether one is coming.

Yes. Rockstar's settings guide lists an accessibility section under Gameplay, high-contrast shaders, text scaling, subtitles and captions, camera comfort options and audio narration. Controls can be remapped separately for walking, aiming, driving, flying and swimming.

Rockstar lists up to 212 GB on PS5, depending on your console, and the Xbox Series X|S install is reported at about 212 GB too. Two updates arrived before launch: about 1 GB on 13 November, then about 600 MB on PS5 and 1.6 GB on Xbox on 16 November. On PS5 you also need Sony's latest system update before the game will start.

items.q: Does the physical edition come with a disc?
items.a: No. Boxed copies contain a download code instead of a disc.

items.q: Can I still get the pre-order bonus?
items.a: Only in a boxed copy, while stocks last. The Vintage Vice City Pack came with digital purchases made before 20 November 2026, so a digital copy bought now doesn't include it.

items.q: Is the Ultimate Edition worth it?
items.a: It adds 16 extras for {diff} more: cars, weapons, outfits, shops and two side activities. Nothing in it is needed to finish the game, so Standard is enough if you only care about the story.
Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos, and you can switch between them. The supporting cast includes Cal Hampton, Brian and Lori Heder, Boobie Ike, Dre'Quan Priest, Real Dimez and Raul Bautista.
In Leonida, Rockstar's version of Florida: Vice City, the Leonida Keys, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, Ambrosia and Mount Kalaga National Park.

items.q: How many wanted stars are there?
items.a: Six, up from five in GTA V.
55 on PlayStation, with matching achievements on Xbox: a Platinum, 2 Gold, 6 Silver and 46 Bronze. Some are hidden.
Nobody knows until people play it. GTA V had cheats but no money cheat. Any GTA 6 cheat list published before launch is made up.
No. Take-Two has said it won't be on Xbox Game Pass at launch.
Rockstar says single-player launches without microtransactions.
